hook.name: hook
hook.reason: The sharp, sudden call out 'Prudence' immediately establishes a tense power dynamic and captures attention.

narrative_tension.name: narrative_tension
narrative_tension.reason: Tension builds steadily as the housekeeper interrogates and sizes up the disguised noblewoman, culminating in her dangerous mission to find the West Wing.

cliffhanger.name: cliffhanger
cliffhanger.reason: The warning that few servants go there establishes a forbidden objective right as the clip cuts off.
cliffhanger.open_question: What is in the West Wing, and why is Lady Juliana risking everything to go where servants aren't allowed?

context_independence.name: context_independence
context_independence.reason: Viewers understand the immediate conflict (surviving the interview), but the larger backstory of why Lady Juliana is undercover remains a mystery.
context_independence.blind_summary: A noblewoman disguised as a maid enters a manor and undergoes a harsh interrogation by the head housekeeper. After passing the test, she immediately asks for directions to the restricted West Wing.

confusions.issue: Why Lady Juliana is disguised as a servant and infiltrating the manor is completely unexplained.

curiosity_gap.name: curiosity_gap
curiosity_gap.reason: It sets up a clear undercover mission with immediate stakes while hiding the ultimate goal.
revealed: Lady Juliana is hiding her identity to work as a servant in Ashbury Manor
The housekeeper is strict and suspicious of new help
withheld: Why a lady of high status is doing servant labor
What is hidden in the West Wing

emotional_impact.name: emotional_impact
emotional_impact.reason: Creates a steady sense of undercover peril and caution.

stakes.value: A noblewoman must fool a ruthless housekeeper to sneak into a forbidden part of the manor.

missing_context: Why Lady Juliana needs to infiltrate this specific manor
